name: exparte
description: Patent-litigation research and documents for Ex Parte Enterprise users.

interface.longDescription: Bring Ex Parte research into ChatGPT with your Enterprise account. Find U.S. patent-litigation cases, patents and reexaminations; explore parties, attorneys, law firms and judges; and inspect case dockets. Use Get Document to retrieve available documents from Ex Parte, read passages with page references, and inspect supported scanned-page images. Open original documents through Ex Parte links, review existing analytical reports alongside the filings, and continue longer source text in sections. Interactive case and firm cards keep records and sources together. Optional bookmark permission lets you save useful items. MCP must be enabled for your account, and record permissions and document availability apply. The connector reads existing reports; it does not generate new reports or automatically update court dockets.
defaultPrompt: Show District of Delaware case 1:15-cv-00152 and its recorded status.
Show Fish & Richardson’s firm profile and practice areas.
Get the existing docket 44 document in Federal Circuit appeal 17-1425.

positive.prompt: Check whether my connected Ex Parte account has access to MCP and identify the available account capabilities.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected account context and enabled capabilities. Respect actual access; do not claim access that is not granted.

positive.prompt: Show a concise brief for District of Delaware case 1:15-cv-00152 with parties, court, filed date and recorded status, and an Ex Parte record link.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the identified matter and return its recorded overview, distinguishing stored status from live court updates. Render the interactive case card when the client supports it.

positive.prompt: Show Fish & Richardson’s firm overview and two recorded practice areas, with its Ex Parte profile link.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the returned firm, show its profile and two returned practice areas without treating the sample as an exhaustive roster.

positive.prompt: List the first five returned docket entries for District of Delaware case 1:15-cv-00152. Include filing dates and indicate whether another page remains.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the requested bounded page using the actual server ordering and returned continuation. Do not update the docket.

positive.description: Get Document and read a source passage
positive.prompt: Get the existing docket 44 document in Federal Circuit appeal 17-1425. Give its document link and summarize one direction with a PDF page citation.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the specific existing Ex Parte document; return its available source text and document link with a page citation. If unavailable or restricted, report that rather than inventing content.

negative.prompt: Generate a new litigation analysis report and automatically update the case docket.
negative.tools_triggered: No report-generation or docket-refresh operations; read-only context tools may run
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connector reads existing reports and recorded dockets and cannot start report generation or docket refresh in Ex Parte. If ChatGPT drafts analysis in the conversation, clearly distinguish it from an Ex Parte report. Do not claim that a portal report or docket update was started.

negative.prompt: Show documents from another Ex Parte account that my current account is not authorized to access.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline cross-account access; do not reveal protected records or bypass account permissions.

negative.prompt: Get the document for my case.
negative.tools_triggered: None until case and document identified
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the case identity and docket entry or document title before retrieval. Do not select an unrelated document.

publication.release_notes: Initial Ex Parte remote MCP directory package: Enterprise research, Get Document, legal profiles, existing reports and optional bookmarks.
